ns2:section.sectionText: Educating Today's Children, 1 hour. First Year Discovery Program Course. This course consists of conversations about education in the year 2010 and beyond. Students will explore the dynamics of teaching and learning as they relate to the educational practices employed in schools, with an emphasis on the changes needed to education. First year Discovery Program course. Registration restricted to freshman. Students should only enroll in one Discovery course. Discovery course. Must have Freshman class standing.
